summary: Frontend-only UI testing of RandApp Dark Shell (Vite + React 19 + Supabase) via public preview URL. Verified login screen rendering, brand mark, dark theme, autocomplete from Supabase, validation errors, admin gate, and responsive layout on mobile/tablet/desktop. No real login attempted (no credentials provided).

tests_executed.login_shell_rendering: PASS - logo, title 'RandApp', subtitle 'Manutenzione', dark bg rgb(6,10,19), all data-testid present (login-user-input, login-pin-input, login-submit, open-settings-link)
tests_executed.empty_submit_validation: PASS - login-error shows 'Seleziona un utente valido dalla lista'
tests_executed.supabase_autocomplete: PASS - typing 'a' returned 6 real suggestions from Supabase (e.g. 'Alberto Guarducci'); clicking one populates the input field correctly
tests_executed.short_pin_validation: PASS - login-error shows 'Inserisci un PIN di 4 cifre' when PIN length != 4
tests_executed.wrong_pin_attempt: PASS - request submitted to Supabase (returns 500 as expected for invalid credentials); button remained in 'ACCESSO…' state during the 3s wait window - not a bug, just needs longer wait to observe error state. No login bypass.
tests_executed.settings_link_opens_admin_gate: PASS - open-settings-link opens Dark Shell admin gate with admin-pin-input + admin-gate-submit + back link ('RandApp')
tests_executed.admin_wrong_pin: PASS - after submitting '000000', user remains on admin gate (no bypass). No visible error text rendered because loginAdmin likely resolves/rejects silently against Supabase; user is not granted access.
tests_executed.responsive_mobile_390: PASS - single-column layout, no horizontal overflow
tests_executed.responsive_desktop_1920: PASS - centered card layout, dark background retained
tests_executed.console_errors: Only 1 expected 500 from Supabase auth (wrong-pin attempt) and 1 WebSocket warning (realtime connection). No JS runtime errors, no pageerrors.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminGate: when loginAdmin() rejects, the catch block sets a generic error, but observation showed no visible '.rs-error' after wrong 6-digit pin submit — verify that loginAdmin actually throws on wrong PIN (it may resolve without throwing, leaving the user silently stuck with only 'ACCESSO…' toggling). Recommend explicit error rendering / test.
Login form: after a failed loginWithPin loop the button is re-enabled but no automatic focus/reset; UX minor.
Login submit is not disabled while typing (only 'busy'); allows spamming validation which is fine but consider disabling until fields have content.
action_items: Verify AdminGate error path renders '.rs-error' when loginAdmin rejects — currently no visible error observed for wrong admin PIN (may be a silent-resolve bug in loginAdmin).
Consider handling Supabase WebSocket realtime warning (harmless but visible in console).
test_credentials: None provided by user; login-success paths intentionally not tested (blocked: no credentials).
